items.title: Is IBM (IBM) Quietly Turning QRadar Into the Core of Its AI Security Investment Story?
items.summary: In July 2026, Resecurity, Inc. launched a native integration for IBM’s QRadar SIEM via the IBM Application Exchange, enabling enterprises to feed standardized STIX/TAXII threat intelligence directly into QRadar for centralized monitoring and correlation of security events. This deeper QRadar ecosystem integration highlights how IBM’s security platform is becoming a hub for AI-ready cyber data, aligning with growing concern about AI-enabled attacks and demand for more automated defenses...
